# Skill: graph-engineering

**Goal:** Schedule DLC engineering and verification as a persistent DAG.

**Tools/standards:** engineering/graph/nodes.json, edges.json, validate.py, receipts.

**Implementation discipline:** Advance nodes only after acceptance; parallel independent branches in isolated worktrees; do not edit governing law to pass a test..

**Evidence required:** Every completed node links tests/logs/commit/platform/environment; regression reopens dependents..

**General constraints:** Never claim full native IDE parity from static parsing. Reuse official APIs and preserve foreign extensions; run builds only in trusted workspaces. Cache tool version, target and provenance, apply graph task gates, and report missing host capabilities. All changes to user devices, signing, or non-workspace files require separate authorization.
